text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and C after large gains felt satisfying, but the gain itself does not justify selling; I should assess their future risk and return.","I held through the declines in Periods 4 and 5. I should make deliberate decisions based on my plan, not let the pain of losses dictate whether I sell or hold.","I added to several stocks in Periods 6 and 9, but recent price moves do not predict what comes next; I should maintain diversification and avoid treating past performance as a forecast."]}
